rationale: The question is whether remote monitoring works in the unit's own service with its own midwives, a pragmatic effectiveness question. Individual allocation on the postnatal ward is possible because monitoring happens at home. Remote monitoring closes the early measurement gap (c1), titration improved six-week control in a small trial (c3), readmission is underpowered (c2), and digital exclusion must be designed out (c4).
alternatives: Introduce remote monitoring for all and compare with last year (refused: secular change and changing case mix)
Stepped introduction by community team (considered: fewer teams than needed for a stable comparison)
Readmission as the primary outcome (refused: about 950 women would be needed)
whyNotMoreComplex: A trial powered for readmission would need about three years of births and more monitors than funded; six-week control is measurable now.

decision.statement: Run a pragmatic trial with individual allocation on the postnatal ward, comparing remote monitoring with midwife hub titration and inclusive reporting options against usual community checks, with blood pressure below 140 over 90 at six weeks as the primary outcome.
decision.question: Should the unit test remote postpartum blood pressure monitoring in a pragmatic trial?

criteria.text: Remote monitoring closes the early measurement gap, titration improved six-week control elsewhere, readmission is underpowered, and inclusion needs design.
The funded monitors cannot be allocated to the trial arm alone.

gates.requirement: Funding for monitors and the app licence
gates.evidence: Charity award HC-2026-017, supplied by the investigator

gates.requirement: Approved medication titration protocol for the hub
gates.evidence: Protocol MAT-HTN-04 approved 2026-06-30, supplied by the investigator

gates.requirement: Research ethics approval of the trial

alternatives: Remote monitoring for all without comparison
decision.note: Rests on ledger claims c1 to c4 from retrieved records; none of the three leads is cited. Ethics approval is unknown, so the action stays blocked.

summary: Pragmatic trial recommended; the decision rests on four ledger claims and waits for ethics approval.
